blocks.text: Signs & Symptoms of Trauma & PTSD

Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD) arises after experiencing or witnessing a traumatic event, such as a serious accident, natural disaster, combat, abuse, or loss of a loved one. This condition is distinguished by intense, disturbing thoughts and feelings related to the trauma that persist long after the event.

intense, disturbing thoughts and feelings

blocks.text: Trauma, on the other hand, is the emotional response to a distressing experience. While not everyone who experiences trauma develops PTSD, the effects of trauma can linger, manifesting as emotional and psychological distress.
Typical Signs and Symptoms of PTSD and Trauma:
Intrusive thoughts or flashbacks of the traumatic event
Avoidance of reminders, places, or people related to the traumatic event
Negative changes in thoughts, mood, or feelings, such as feelings of hopelessness, irritability, or emotional numbness
Heightened reactions, including being easily startled or experiencing outbursts of anger
Emotional distress or difficulty managing everyday life
Recognize that reaching out for help is a courageous step towards healing. It’s time to seek support if you notice these symptoms persist and interfere with your daily life or relationships.

At Garden Springs Wellness, your treatment starts with a thorough assessment to tailor a treatment plan that addresses your specific needs. Expect a collaborative approach with a focus on therapy, skill development, and, if needed, medication management to help restore stability.
